title: Decision-6 native metadata reference, filter, promotion, alias, state, aggregation, merge, lifecycle and work-accounting semantics: executable incumbent controls plus accepted target cases

target_cases.accepted: Isolated target scenario at evaluation 2000. Left series iso_left_total{job="api",instance="a"} has sample value 7 and Resource content {zone="east",host.name="left-host"}; right series iso_right_total{job="api",instance="a"} has sample value 2 and Resource content {zone="west",host.name="right-host"}. Plain selectors return exactly {__name__="iso_left_total", __otel_resource__="<resource-left>", instance="a", job="api"} 7 and {__name__="iso_right_total", __otel_resource__="<resource-right>", instance="a", job="api"} 2; neither result carries zone or host_name. iso_left_total{zone="east"} returns nothing, because metadata is not an ordinary matcher target. The binary expression iso_left_total + on(job, instance) iso_right_total returns exactly one combined series {instance="a", job="api"} 9: default arithmetic drops __name__, on(...) retains only the matching labels, and the differing Resource metadata is not a matching key. If metadata participated in matching, the expression would produce no series, so the result discriminates metadata inclusion. A selector-local ~resource.zone as resource_zone on the left operand changes only that operand's output; an ordinary right operand in the same expression is not enriched. Error class: none for these forms; a direct metadata reference in a group_left include list is the validation error in target 9.
target_cases.reason: The incumbent has no ~ or ~~ reference token and no selector-local projection. The plain-selector, ordinary-matcher and vector-matching controls are executable and asserted by this fixture; the accepted projection/alias behavior is not. info() promotes into the whole vector without a selector-local alias, so it is not evidence for this target.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated target scenario at 2000 with one series name_probe_total{job="api",instance="a"} value 7 and Resource content host.name="a-host", host\name="escaped-host", 主机名="unicode-host", zone="east"; Scope content name="sdk-scope"; Metric content name="metric-name"; Scrape content name="scrape-b"; Resource-schema content version="schema-v1". Filters use explicit value predicates. ~~resource.host.name = "a-host" and ~~resource."host.name" = "a-host" both return the series with labels {__name__="name_probe_total", __otel_resource__="<resource>", instance="a", job="api"} 7. ~~resource."host\\name" = "escaped-host" addresses the distinct exact key host\name and does not match a-host. ~~resource."主机名" = "unicode-host" matches the Unicode key. ~~scope.name = "sdk-scope", ~~metric.name = "metric-name", ~~scrape.name = "scrape-b" and ~~resource_schema.version = "schema-v1" each stay in their own namespace and never match the Resource value. ~~resource.zone.extra = "x" is one exact flattened key named zone.extra, not a path into zone. Empty category ~~.zone = "east", unknown category ~~team.owner = "x" and empty key ~~resource. = "x" fail with metadata_reference_error. No legacy label-name sanitization is applied. Error class: metadata_reference_error for the malformed category or key forms, none for the exact-name filters.
target_cases.reason: The parser rejects the first ~ with unexpected character, so dotted, quoted, escaped, Unicode and category-isolated keys cannot be distinguished. Content has no category namespace exposed to PromQL, and no metadata reference grammar exists.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated target scenario at 2000 with series typed_probe_total{job="api",instance="a"} value 7 and typed Resource content {s:"1", i:1, d:1.0, b:true, a:[1,2], m:map{k=1,j="x"}, n:null}. ~~resource.s = "1" returns {__name__="typed_probe_total", __otel_resource__="<resource>", instance="a", job="api"} 7; ~~resource.s = 1 returns nothing. ~~resource.i = 1 matches only integer 1, ~~resource.d = 1.0 matches only double 1.0, and ~~resource.i = 1.0 does not match. ~~resource.b = true matches only boolean true. ~~resource.a = [1,2] matches the ordered array and ~~resource.a = [2,1] does not. ~~resource.m = map{k=1,j="x"} and ~~resource.m = map{j="x",k=1} match the same map regardless of iteration order, while ~~resource.m = map{k=2,j="x"} does not. ~~resource.n = null matches typed null; ~~resource.absent = null does not, because typed null is not absent. Matching is same-type exact equality only: a cross-type literal is false, not a stringified match. Error class: none.
target_cases.reason: Content.Attributes is map[string]string with no boolean, integer, double, array, map or null representation, so integer 1, double 1.0 and string "1" cannot stay distinct and no map{...} or other typed literal can be evaluated.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated target scenario at 2000 with series bits_probe_total{job="api",instance="a"} value 7 and typed double Resource content negzero=-0.0 (bits 0x8000000000000000), poszero=0.0 (bits 0x0000000000000000) and nan1=double_bits(0x7ff8000000000001). ~~resource.negzero = -0.0 and ~~resource.negzero = double_bits(0x8000000000000000) return {__name__="bits_probe_total", __otel_resource__="<resource>", instance="a", job="api"} 7; ~~resource.negzero = 0.0 and ~~resource.negzero = double_bits(0x0000000000000000) return nothing. ~~resource.poszero = 0.0 matches and ~~resource.poszero = -0.0 does not. ~~resource.nan1 = double_bits(0x7ff8000000000001) matches that NaN payload only; double_bits(0x7ff8000000000002) does not. A bare = NaN literal is a validation error, and an ordered comparison such as ~~resource.poszero > 0.0 is deferred and rejected. Error class: metadata_literal_error for the unsupported literal and for the deferred ordered comparison, none for the bit-exact comparisons.
target_cases.reason: Metadata values are strings, so signed zero, NaN payload identity and double_bits(...) have no representation. The incumbent cannot compare bits and has no metadata literal parser or ordered-comparison path.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated target scenario at 2000 with series regex_probe_total{job="api",instance="a"} value 7 and Resource content zone="east", region="east-1", typed integer replicas=2, boolean enabled=true, array tags=["a","b"], and no missing key. ~~resource.zone != "west" and ~~resource.zone !~ "we.*" return {__name__="regex_probe_total", __otel_resource__="<resource>", instance="a", job="api"} 7; ~~resource.region =~ "^ea" returns the same series. ~~resource.missing != "west" and ~~resource.missing !~ "we.*" return nothing, because a positive or negative value predicate requires a present value. ~~resource.replicas =~ "2", ~~resource.enabled =~ "true" and regex against an array, map or null fail with metadata_type_error; regex is string-only. Error class: metadata_type_error for a non-string regex operand, none for the valid negative and regex string cases.
target_cases.reason: There is no native negative, regex or state-aware value predicate. Attribute matching is string-only but has no typed rejection path, and an absent key can satisfy an empty-string matcher (defect-absent-empty-filter), so the accepted present-value requirement cannot execute.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated target scenario at 2000 with promote_probe_total{job="api",instance="a"} value 7 and Resource zone="east", and promote_probe_total{job="api",instance="b"} value 5 with no Resource zone. promote_probe_total ~~resource.zone = "east" filters to instance a and returns exactly {__name__="promote_probe_total", __otel_resource__="<resource>", instance="a", job="api"} 7 with no promoted label. promote_probe_total ~resource.zone = "east" filters to instance a and adds the default category-qualified label resource_zone="east". promote_probe_total ~resource.zone projects resource_zone="east" on instance a without a value predicate and leaves instance b present with no resource_zone label. promote_probe_total ~resource.zone as zone_view projects zone_view="east" on instance a and no zone_view on instance b. A bare promote_probe_total ~~resource.zone is invalid. Error class: metadata_reference_error for the bare double-tilde form, none for the others.
target_cases.reason: Neither ~ nor ~~ exists. The incumbent only has info(), which is a separate function with legacy promotion rules and no projection alias, and a bare ~~ reference cannot be parsed.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated target scenario at 2000 with alias_left_total{job="api",instance="a"} value 7 and Resource zone="east", and alias_right_total{job="api",instance="a"} value 2 and Resource zone="west". alias_left_total ~resource.zone as left_zone + on(job, instance) group_left alias_right_total returns one combined series {__otel_resource__="<resource-left>", instance="a", job="api", left_zone="east"} 9; default arithmetic drops __name__, group_left keeps the left label set, and no right label is copied. alias_left_total + on(job, instance) group_left(right_zone) alias_right_total ~resource.zone as right_zone returns {__otel_resource__="<resource-left>", instance="a", job="api", right_zone="west"} 9; without the include list, right_zone is not copied and the result is {__otel_resource__="<resource-left>", instance="a", job="api"} 9. The one-to-one expression alias_left_total ~resource.zone as left_zone + on(job, instance) alias_right_total ~resource.zone as right_zone returns one combined series {__otel_resource__="<resource-left>", instance="a", job="api", left_zone="east"} 9; right_zone does not survive a one-to-one arithmetic result. Adding group_left(right_zone) to the same expression yields {__otel_resource__="<resource-left>", instance="a", job="api", left_zone="east", right_zone="west"} 9. Aliases are selector-local and never leak to the other side. Error class: none.
target_cases.reason: There is no alias syntax or selector-side projection. Default PromQL arithmetic also drops __name__ and one-to-one results keep only the left label set, so the accepted side-specific behavior cannot be expressed or observed.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated target scenario at 2000: group_probe_total{job="api",instance="a"} value 7 and group_probe_total{job="api",instance="b"} value 5 share Resource owner G with content zone="east"; group_probe_total{job="api",instance="c"} value 3 has no Resource. sum by (resource_zone) (group_probe_total ~resource.zone as resource_zone) returns {resource_zone="east"} 12 and {} 3; the unattributed input yields an empty ordinary label set, not resource_zone="" as a surviving label. sum without (resource_zone, instance) (group_probe_total ~resource.zone as resource_zone) returns {__otel_resource__="<resource-g>", job="api"} 12 and {job="api"} 3. sum without (resource_zone) (group_probe_total ~resource.zone as resource_zone) returns {__otel_resource__="<resource-g>", instance="a", job="api"} 7, {__otel_resource__="<resource-g>", instance="b", job="api"} 5 and {instance="c", job="api"} 3. group_probe_total ~resource.zone as resource_zone + on(job, instance, resource_zone) group_probe_total ~resource.zone as resource_zone returns {instance="a", job="api", resource_zone="east"} 14, {instance="b", job="api", resource_zone="east"} 10 and {instance="c", job="api"} 6, because on(...) retains only the matching labels. Binary matching with ignoring(zone) uses only ordinary labels, and an absent ordinary label is not invented. Error class: none.
target_cases.reason: No promotion or alias exists, so by/without/on/ignoring never see a promoted metadata label. The incumbent can group only by ordinary input labels, and info() is not a selector projection that can feed those modifiers.

target_cases.accepted: Each of sum by (~~resource.zone) (native_probe_total), sum without (~~resource.zone) (native_probe_total), native_probe_total + on(~~resource.zone) native_probe_total, native_probe_total + ignoring(~~resource.zone) native_probe_total and native_probe_total + on(job) group_left(~~resource.zone) native_probe_total is rejected at validation because a direct metadata reference is not an ordinary label in by/without/on/ignoring/grouping modifiers. Error class: metadata_reference_error; no series, partial result or uncertainty annotation is returned, and no fallback parses the reference as an ordinary label name.
target_cases.reason: The parser rejects the reference token before modifier validation can run, so the accepted explicit rejection class and its no-fallback rule have no implementation.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated target scenario at 2000 with two Resource-associated series sharing owner R (Resource zone="east"): collision_probe_total{job="api",instance="a"} value 7, which lacks an ordinary resource_zone label, and collision_probe_total{job="api",instance="a",resource_zone="east"} value 5, which already has resource_zone="east". Promoting the first with ~resource.zone would make its complete output label set {__name__="collision_probe_total", __otel_resource__="<resource-r>", instance="a", job="api", resource_zone="east"} identical to the second, so the duplicate-displayed-series collision fails with metadata_promotion_collision and returns no series, including neither 7 nor 5. ~resource.zone as zone fails if the input series already has ordinary zone="base-zone"; ~resource.zone as __name__ fails because __name__ is reserved; ~resource.zone as dup together with ~scope.name as dup fails because two references produce the same output name. Error class: metadata_promotion_collision for every collision, with no partial result.
target_cases.reason: No promotion exists, so the incumbent has no output-name allocation, reserved-name rule, duplicate-alias rule or duplicate-displayed-series detection. Current info() no-overwrite behavior has no error class and no collision rule for native projection.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated target scenario at 2000 with empty_probe_total{job="api",instance="empty"} value 7 whose Resource content has zone="" present, and absent_probe_total{job="api",instance="absent"} value 5 whose Resource content omits zone. empty_probe_total ~~resource.zone = "" returns {__name__="empty_probe_total", __otel_resource__="<resource-empty>", instance="empty", job="api"} 7; absent_probe_total ~~resource.zone = "" returns nothing. absent_probe_total ~~resource.region = "" returns nothing. empty_probe_total ~resource.zone as zone_view on the present empty string fails with metadata_promotion_type, as does promotion of an integer, double, boolean, array, map or null value. Error class: metadata_promotion_type for empty and non-string or null promotion; no numeric, boolean, array or map stringification occurs.
target_cases.reason: map[string]string can distinguish a present empty string from an absent key through key membership, so this is not a structural storage impossibility. The gap is the current lookup/query semantics: an absent key can satisfy an empty-string matcher (defect-absent-empty-filter), there is no state predicate, and no promotion operation exists to raise the accepted promotion error.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated target scenario at evaluation 2000. Value axis on state_value_total{job="api"}: instance "present" value 1 has Resource host.name="a-host"; instance "null" value 2 has host.name=null; instance "absent" value 3 has complete Resource content omitting host.name; instance "cleared" value 4 has host.name explicitly cleared at 1000; instance "unknown" value 5 has a partial source that does not report host.name; instance "ambiguous" value 6 is read through a fanout/combined view with two owners claiming host.name="a-host" and host.name="b-host". state_value_total{metadata_state(~~resource."host.name", "value") = "present"} returns {__name__="state_value_total", __otel_resource__="<resource-present>", instance="present", job="api"} 1 with no uncertainty annotation. = "null" returns the instance "null" series value 2 with no annotation; = "absent" returns the instance "absent" series value 3 with no annotation; = "cleared" returns the instance "cleared" series value 4 with no annotation. = "unknown" returns the instance "unknown" series value 5 with annotation {reference=~~resource."host.name", state="unknown", interval=[2000,2000]}; = "ambiguous" returns the instance "ambiguous" series value 6 with annotation {reference=~~resource."host.name", state="ambiguous", interval=[2000,2000]}. Association axis on state_association_total{job="api"}: instance "applicable" value 1 has membership [1000,3000); instance "unassociated" value 2 has membership gap at 2000; instance "never_observed" value 3 has no association observation; instance "terminated" value 4 has membership [1000,2000) terminated at 2000; instance "unknown" value 5 has truncated association coverage; instance "ambiguous" value 6 is a fanout/combined view with conflicting memberships. state_association_total{metadata_state(~~resource."host.name", "association") = "applicable"} returns the applicable series value 1 with no annotation; = "unassociated" returns value 2 with no annotation; = "never_observed" returns value 3 with no annotation; = "terminated" returns value 4 with no annotation; = "unknown" returns value 5 with annotation {reference=~~resource."host.name", state="unknown", interval=[2000,2000]}; = "ambiguous" returns value 6 with annotation {reference=~~resource."host.name", state="ambiguous", interval=[2000,2000]}. Coverage axis on state_coverage_total{job="api"}: instance "covered" value 1 has complete retained coverage; instance "unknown" value 2 has no coverage observation; instance "truncated" value 3 has discarded history; instance "coalesced_lossless" value 4 has an equivalent redundant successor coalesced with no information loss; instance "coalesced_lossy" value 5 has coalescing that discarded distinct observation detail. state_coverage_total{metadata_state(~~resource."host.name", "coverage") = "covered"} returns value 1 with no annotation; = "unknown" returns value 2 with annotation {reference=~~resource."host.name", state="unknown", interval=[2000,2000]}; = "truncated" returns value 3 with annotation {reference=~~resource."host.name", state="truncated", interval=[2000,2000]}; = "coalesced_lossless" returns value 4 with no annotation; = "coalesced_lossy" returns value 5 with annotation {reference=~~resource."host.name", state="coalesced_lossy", interval=[2000,2000]}. Unknown axes or states fail with metadata_state_error, including metadata_state(~~resource."host.name", "freshness") = "present", metadata_state(~~resource."host.name", "value") = "missing", metadata_state(~~resource."host.name", "association") = "present" and metadata_state(~~resource."host.name", "coverage") = "applicable". State selection creates no promoted label and no magic empty-string value: every result retains only its original ordinary labels and no host.name, metadata_state or empty-string label. Error class: metadata_state_error for unknown axis or state names, none for the listed states.
target_cases.reason: metadata_state is an unknown function to the parser, so the explicit comparison form cannot parse. The incumbent exposes no value, association or coverage state model, no clear, termination, truncation, coalescing or ambiguity state, and no query-level uncertainty annotation.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated fanout/combined-view target scenario at 2000. Series ambiguity_probe_total{job="api",instance="a"} value 7 is read from two queriers: querier 1 reports Resource owner A with host.name="a-host", querier 2 reports Resource owner B with host.name="b-host". A local same-time conflict would reject ingestion under decision 2; this target is legal only as a read-side fanout/combined view. metadata_state(~~resource."host.name", "value") = "ambiguous" returns {__name__="ambiguity_probe_total", instance="a", job="api"} 7 with annotation {reference=~~resource."host.name", state="ambiguous", interval=[2000,2000]}. ~~resource."host.name" = "a-host" and ~~resource."host.name" = "b-host" both return nothing, and a regex ~~resource."host.name" =~ ".*" returns nothing; no owner is selected and no host.name="" or other invented label is added. A truncated owner queried with ~~resource.zone = "east" returns no value and annotation {reference=~~resource.zone, state="truncated", interval=[2000,2000]}, not an empty success. An unknown annotation name in metadata_state(~~resource.zone, "coverage") = "invented" fails with metadata_state_error rather than being coerced. A coalesced_lossless successor leaves one continuous band with no invented intermediate value and no uncertainty annotation; a coalesced_lossy successor reports state coalesced_lossy with annotation {reference=~~resource.zone, state="coalesced_lossy", interval=[2000,2000]}. Error class: metadata_state_error for the unknown annotation; ambiguity, truncation and lossy coalescing are states, not errors.
target_cases.reason: The incumbent has no annotation, truncation-state query, uncertainty annotation or explicit read-side ambiguity representation. A local same-time owner conflict is rejected at commit under decision 2, and no merged read exposes ambiguity, so no value-invention rule can be exercised.

target_cases.accepted: Two isolated target scenarios. A/B/A scenario: temporal_aba_total{job="api",instance="a",zone="base-zone"} has samples 1000=1, 2000=7 and 3000=9; Resource content is A zone="east" on [1000,2000), B zone="west" on [2000,3000) and A zone="east" from 3000; association is applicable from 1000. temporal_aba_total{~~resource.zone = "east"} returns {__name__="temporal_aba_total", __otel_resource__="<resource-a>", instance="a", job="api", zone="base-zone"} 1 at 1000; the same labels and value 1 at 1999 because the 1000 sample is inside lookback but the content at 1999 is still east; nothing at 2000 or 2999; and the same east labels with value 9 at 3000. = "west" returns the corresponding west labels with value 7 at 2000 and 2999, nothing at 1999 and 3000. A/B/A produces one contribution per step, never 9+1 or 9+7. @ 1000 at query time 3000 resolves at the shifted timestamp 1000 and returns the east labels value 1. offset 1m with = "west" at query time 2060 resolves at 2000 and returns the west labels value 7. Lookback with = "east" at 2500 selects the sample at 2000 by lookback but resolves owner/content at 2500, where the content is west, so east returns nothing; = "west" at 2500 returns the west labels value 7. Matrix gating uses temporal_aba_total{~~resource.zone = "east"}[2m]: at evaluation 1999 the current step is east and the matrix contains the 1000 sample, {__name__="temporal_aba_total", __otel_resource__="<resource-a>", instance="a", job="api", zone="base-zone"} 1@1000; at evaluation 2000 the current step is west, so the matrix is empty even though the range still contains the east sample from 1000. The predicate gates the step, not each sample by its timestamp. Clear/termination/reappearance scenario: temporal_lifecycle_total{job="api",instance="b",zone="base-zone"} has samples 1000=1, 3500=5, 4500=6 and 5000=11; Resource content is A zone="east" on [1000,3000), explicitly cleared on [3000,4000) and A zone="east" from 4000; association is [1000,4000), explicitly terminated on [4000,5000) and reappears from 5000. = "east" returns nothing at 3500 because the key is cleared, not empty; returns nothing at 4500 because the association is terminated even though the content is east; and returns {__name__="temporal_lifecycle_total", __otel_resource__="<resource-b>", instance="b", job="api", zone="base-zone"} 11 at 5000 after association reappearance. Content and association histories remain independent and no step is multiplied. Error class: none.
target_cases.reason: The incumbent has no native temporal predicate, no clear, termination or reappearance representation, and no matrix-step gating. Native info() resolves at evaluation time for a single instant, but the accepted @/offset, lookback, matrix and clear/reappearance rules cannot execute through a metadata reference.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated target scenario at 2000: agg_probe_total{job="api",instance="a"} value 7 with Resource zone="east"; agg_probe_total{job="api",instance="b"} value 5 with no Resource. Legal pre-aggregation references: sum(agg_probe_total{~~resource.zone = "east"}) and sum(agg_probe_total ~~resource.zone = "east") both return {} 7; a reference inside sum(...) is part of the input selector, not a post-aggregation reference. True post-aggregation reference: info(sum(agg_probe_total), {~~resource.zone = "east"}) fails with metadata_aggregation_error because info()'s second argument requires a reference identity already discarded by the aggregate; the query returns no series, no partial result and no uncertainty annotation. Preserved legacy controls: sum(agg_probe_total) returns {} 12; sum by (job) (agg_probe_total) returns {job="api"} 12; sum(info(agg_probe_total)) returns {} 12; info(sum(agg_probe_total)) returns {} 12 and does not invent a Resource association for the aggregate. Unattributed instance b survives the projection agg_probe_total ~resource.zone as resource_zone without a resource_zone label and is not converted to known absence. Error class: metadata_aggregation_error for the post-aggregation form, none for the legal pre-aggregation and legacy controls.
target_cases.reason: A native reference in info() second argument cannot parse, so the true post-aggregation rejection class cannot be produced. References inside sum(...) are input selectors; the existing info() controls are executable but are not decision-6 native-reference evidence.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated target scenario: transition_probe_total{job="api",instance="a"} has samples 1000=1, 2000=7 and 3000=9. At 1000 the applicable owner is Resource A with zone="east"; at 2000 it is Resource B with zone="west"; at 3000 it is Resource A again. transition_probe_total{~~resource.zone = "east"} returns {__name__="transition_probe_total", __otel_resource__="<resource-a>", instance="a", job="api"} 1 at 1000, nothing at 2000, and the same east labels with value 9 at 3000. = "west" returns {__name__="transition_probe_total", __otel_resource__="<resource-b>", instance="a", job="api"} 7 at 2000 and nothing at 1000 or 3000. The plain selector returns values 1, 7 and 9 at those times, one contribution per input sample, never a doubled value such as 14. Owner and membership transitions create ordered bands with inclusive starts and exclusive successors, and a series present in both an old and a new owner's candidate set is enriched once per evaluation step. Error class: none.
target_cases.reason: Membership transitions themselves are executable, but native-reference enrichment over those bands does not exist. Current info() resolves one applicable version and does not provide the once-per-step native contribution rule.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated target scenario at 2000 with domain_probe_total{job="api",instance="a"} value 7; Resource content {name="resource-name", zone="east"}; Scope content {name="scope-name", zone="scope-zone"}; Metric content {name="metric-name"}; Scrape content {name="scrape-name"}; Resource-schema content {version="schema-v1"}. ~~resource.name = "resource-name" returns {__name__="domain_probe_total", __otel_resource__="<resource>", instance="a", job="api"} 7; ~~scope.name = "scope-name", ~~metric.name = "metric-name", ~~scrape.name = "scrape-name" and ~~resource_schema.version = "schema-v1" each return the same series from their own namespace. ~~resource.name = "scope-name" and ~~scope.name = "resource-name" each return nothing; ~~resource.zone = "east" matches, while ~~scope.zone = "east" returns nothing because the Scope value is scope-zone. Same-named keys never cross-match categories and no cross-domain match is inferred. Error class: none.
target_cases.reason: The six owner namespaces exist in storage but are not addressable from PromQL at all. The parser rejects the category syntax, so same-named keys and the no-cross-domain-match rule cannot be exercised.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated decision-5-ready target scenario at 2000 with source_probe_total{job="api",instance="a"} value 7 and a typed Source provenance record carrying the producer, sender and transport roles over an explicit non-identifying channel. Role discovery addresses the roles abstractly, for example ~~source.<role> = <typed component>, where <role> is a decision-5 role name; the exact supplied Source key and projection schema are deliberately not fixed here and are not evidence for source.transport, source.producer or any other exact field. metadata_state(~~source.<role>, "value") = "present" is true for a present role component. Discovery returns the role values without adding __otel_resource__, a Resource attribute, an info() label or an ordinary series label; Source content never enters vector identity or Resource identity fallback. The retained label set is {__name__="source_probe_total", __otel_resource__="<resource>", instance="a", job="api"} and no Source label or role value appears in it. Exact Source record layout, supplied keys and projection schema remain unchosen. Error class: none.
target_cases.reason: Decision 5 typed Source provenance is unimplemented and no native source reference or state predicate exists. The incumbent stores one opaque Source owner string with opaque content; no supplied role-key or projection schema has been selected, so an oracle must not invent one.

target_cases.accepted: Two isolated lifecycle scenarios. Retained-result equality: lifecycle_probe_total{job="api",instance="a"} has samples 1000=1, 2000=7 and 5000=11; Resource zone="east" and association are applicable at all three times. lifecycle_probe_total{~~resource.zone = "east"} returns {__name__="lifecycle_probe_total", __otel_resource__="<resource>", instance="a", job="api"} 1 at 1000, the same labels with 7 at 2000, and the same labels with 11 at 5000, identically before and after WAL replay, flush, compaction and reopen. Post-retention discarded coverage is separate: a store with retained_version_limit=1 discards the earlier zone="east" band after a successor zone="west" at 2000; a query at 1500 using ~~resource.zone = "east" depends on discarded coverage and must report annotation {reference=~~resource.zone, state="truncated", interval=[1500,1500]} rather than an absent-like empty success or an invented east value. A query at 2000 using = "west" returns the west value and covered content. Stable-band reuse survives reopen and changes no retained label or value. No persistence operation resurrects a cleared or terminated band. Error class: none for the retained results; the discarded-coverage query returns the truncation state, not a successful empty result.
target_cases.reason: The underlying metadata lifecycle is executable, but the accepted decision-6 query semantics and truncation annotation are not. No native predicate or promoted label can be run before and after replay, and no truncation-aware query state exists.

target_cases.accepted: Two isolated target workloads. Complete PromQL range query: work_probe_total{job="api",instance="a"} has samples 1000=1, 1500=4 and 2000=7 with one unchanged Resource band zone="east" on [1000,3000); work_probe_total{job="api",instance="b"} has samples 1000=3, 1500=5 and 2000=9 with no Resource. work_probe_total ~resource.zone as resource_zone over start=1000, end=2000, step=500 returns the matrix: instance a at 1000 with {__name__="work_probe_total", __otel_resource__="<resource>", instance="a", job="api", resource_zone="east"} 1, at 1500 the same labels value 4, at 2000 the same labels value 7; instance b at 1000 with {__name__="work_probe_total", instance="b", job="api"} 3, at 1500 value 5, at 2000 value 9. Work shape: stable_band_resolutions=1, selected_sample_reads=6 for the full PromQL query, and label_materializations=6 for two output series across three evaluation steps. These are counts, not latency or throughput claims. Metadata-only read: a reverse Resource query for attribute zone="east" over [1000,2000] returns exactly the owner-A row with its membership and version bounds, sample_payload_opens=0 and segments_read=0. The zero-sample-read claim applies only to that metadata-only path. A filter-only PromQL query that returns samples still reads selected samples and must not claim zero. Error class: none.

target_cases.accepted: Isolated fanout target scenario at 2000 for merge_probe_total{job="api",instance="a"} value 7. Both queriers return the identical complete record for Resource owner A with zone="east" on [1000,2000); the equal records deduplicate to one observation. Querier 1 then returns zone="east" on [1000,2000) and querier 2 returns zone="west" on [2000,3000); the complementary bands both survive with retained coverage equal to the union, and the merged result at 2000 uses the west band at its inclusive start. Querier 1 returns owner A zone="east" and querier 2 returns owner B zone="west" at the same effective time 2000; the result is explicit ambiguity, returning {__name__="merge_probe_total", instance="a", job="api"} 7 with annotation {reference=~~resource.zone, state="ambiguous", interval=[2000,2000]}, not newest-wins by querier order, arrival order or map iteration. In the ambiguous case ~~resource.zone = "east" and ~~resource.zone = "west" both return nothing, and no owner or value is chosen. Missing Resource data from querier 2 does not erase querier 1's known zone="east"; the known value survives with the union of retained coverage. Equivalent records deduplicate; unequal equal-time content or owners stay ambiguous. This is the decision-6 typed, applicability/coverage/ambiguity-preserving reference merge, not the incumbent's separate Resource merge. Error class: none; ambiguity is a state with an uncertainty annotation.
target_cases.reason: The incumbent has no decision-6 typed reference result to merge and no ambiguity state or uncertainty annotation. Its existing distributed Resource merge path is separate and is not evidence for the accepted typed, coverage-preserving reference merge.
